details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") and its index.js also invokes the same beacon on require, so simply installing or importing the package sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package. The JSON body contains only host metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), the npm/node user agent string, and the protocol. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and the package performs no other operation; index.js exports a no-op Proxy so importing code does not crash. The package describes itself as an authorized dependency-confusion test.
